title: 第196章 五行合一自成一界第195章 他越强我越兴奋
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
哗啦啦！
只见天空中，三色雷云猛然收缩了一下，然后如同决堤的洪水般倾泻而下。
顿时，无数道雷霆从云层中劈落，不是一道两道，而是成百上千道同时轰下。
首先，紫金色的紫霄神雷化作一条条雷龙。
接着，赤金色的大日焚天雷凝成一头头雷凤。
而混沌灭世雷则化作一柄柄形态各异的兵器，刀枪剑戟、斧钺钩叉、钟鼎塔炉，甚至还有古琴、棋盘、书卷、画卷....
“万兵雷劫！”
此刻，易师在远处看得目眦欲裂。
要知道，这是雷劫化形中最恐怖的几种形态之一！
雷劫会将天地间所有兵器的杀伐之意凝聚成形，每一柄雷兵都相当于一位准帝的全力一击...
而且这些雷兵会根据渡劫者的弱点自行演化，专门攻击渡劫者法则中最薄弱的一环！
他的话音未落，那万千雷兵已经如同暴雨般倾泻在五行华盖上....
铛铛铛铛铛！
顷刻间，密集的撞击声连成一片，几乎分辨不出间隙。
同时，五行华盖剧烈震颤，五色光芒在雷兵的轰击下快速消耗，，，，
呼呼呼！
此刻，左丘辰双手结印，体内五行法则疯狂输出，维持着华盖不碎。
但雷兵的攻势实在太密集太狂暴了，仅仅扛过了第一轮轰击，五行华盖的表面就出现了细密的裂纹...
“好，这才够劲！”
左丘辰不惊反喜，眼中战意更浓。

唰！
下一刻，他猛地撤去五行华盖，竟然主动暴露在了万千雷兵的轰击之下。
“哟，玩的还挺大！”
这时，萧飞也是看着左丘辰的操作开口道。
但下一刻，所有人都瞪大了眼睛。
只见左丘辰没有躲闪，也没有防御，而是迎着那万千雷兵伸出了双手。
他的十指虚张，掌心处同时亮起五色法则光芒....
呼呼呼！
刹那间，金木水火土五行法则在掌心凝聚成十个微型的法则漩涡，十个漩涡同时旋转，产生了十股截然不同的吸力。
“五行吞天！”
左丘辰暴喝一声，十股吸力同时爆发。
而那些呼啸而来的雷兵在这十股吸力的牵引下竟然偏离了原本的轨迹，纷纷朝他掌心汇聚过来....
接着，让人震惊的事情发生了。
只见，紫金色的雷龙被吸入金属性漩涡！
赤金色的雷凤被吸入火属性漩涡！
混沌色的雷兵则被五行漩涡强行撕扯成最本源的混沌雷力，再分配到五个漩涡中....
他竟然在炼化雷劫！
“这……这他妈只有你才能干出这种事！”
顿时，萧飞张大了嘴巴。
而易师更是整个人都呆住了。

他活了这么多年，见过无数天才渡劫，有硬扛的，有躲避的，有用法宝抵挡的，甚至有利用阵法分散雷劫威力的....
但像左丘辰这样主动炼化雷劫的，他别说见过，连听都没听说过！
那可是天地间最狂暴的雷罚之力啊！
要知道，寻常修士沾上一丝都要肉身崩碎、神魂俱灭，他居然当成补品来吸收？
content_en:
Wow!
I saw three-colored thunderclouds in the sky suddenly shrinking, and then pouring down like a flood that broke a bank.
Suddenly, countless thunderbolts crashed down from the clouds, not one or two, but hundreds or thousands of thunderbolts struck simultaneously.
First, the purple-gold Zixiao Divine Thunder turned into thunder dragons.
Then, the red-gold sun-burning thunder condensed into thunder phoenixes.
The chaotic world-destroying thunder turned into weapons of different shapes, such as swords, guns, swords and halberds, axes, hooks and forks, bells, tripods, towers, furnaces, and even guqins, chessboards, books, scrolls...
"Thousands of soldiers and thunder calamity!"
At this moment, Master Yi was looking at it from a distance and his eyes were about to burst.
You know, this is one of the most terrifying forms among thunder tribulation transformations!
Thunder Tribulation will condense the killing intent of all weapons in the world into shape. Each thunder weapon is equivalent to a full blow of a quasi-emperor...
Moreover, these thunder soldiers will evolve on their own according to the weaknesses of the tribulation warriors, specifically attacking the weakest link in the tribulation warrior's laws!
Before he finished speaking, the thousands of thunder soldiers were already pouring down on the Five Elements Canopy like a torrential rain...
Clang, clang, clang!
In an instant, the dense impact sounds merged into one, and the gaps were almost indistinguishable.
At the same time, the Five Elements Canopy trembled violently, and the five-color light was quickly consumed under the bombardment of the thunder soldiers.,,,
Hoo ho ho!
At this moment, Zuo Qiuchen formed seals with his hands, and the Five Elements Law in his body was outputting wildly, keeping the canopy unbroken.
But the Lei soldiers' offensive was too intensive and violent. After only surviving the first round of bombardment, fine cracks appeared on the surface of the Five Elements Canopy...
"Okay, that's enough!"
Zuo Qiuchen was not surprised but happy, and his eyes were filled with more fighting spirit.
Uh-huh!
The next moment, he suddenly removed the Five Elements Canopy, and was actually exposed to the bombardment of thousands of thunder soldiers.
"Oh, it's quite a big game!"
At this time, Xiao Fei also looked at Zuo Qiuchen's operation and said.
But the next moment, everyone's eyes widened.
Zuo Qiuchen did not dodge or defend, but stretched out his hands to face the thousands of thunder soldiers.
His ten fingers were bluffing, and the five-color law lights lit up at the same time...
Hoo ho ho!
In an instant, the laws of the five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth condensed into ten miniature law vortices in the palm of the hand. The ten vortices rotated at the same time, producing ten completely different suction forces.
"Five elements swallow the sky!"
Zuo Qiuchen shouted loudly, and ten suction forces exploded at the same time.
And those thunder soldiers that were roaring towards him actually deviated from their original trajectory under the pull of these ten suction forces, and they all converged towards his palm...
Then, something shocking happened.
I saw the purple-gold thunder dragon being sucked into the metallic vortex!
The red-gold thunder phoenix was sucked into the fire attribute vortex!
The chaotic thunder soldiers were forcibly torn apart by the five-element vortex into the most original chaotic thunder power, and then distributed into the five whirlpools...
He is actually refining Thunder Tribulation!
"This...only you can fucking do this kind of thing!"
Suddenly, Xiao Fei opened his mouth wide.
Master Yi was completely stunned.
He has lived for so many years and has seen countless geniuses overcome tribulations, some with force, some with avoidance, some with magic weapons to resist, and some even with formations to disperse the power of thunder tribulations...
But for someone like Zuo Qiuchen who took the initiative to refine the Thunder Tribulation, he had never even heard of it, let alone seen it!
That is the most violent thunder and punishment power in the world!
You know, ordinary monks would have their bodies shattered and their souls destroyed if they got even a trace of it, but he actually absorbed it as a tonic?
